title: When AI Speaks, Whose Values Does It Express? A Cross-Cultural Audit of Individualism–Collectivism Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Presenting models with behavioral personal dilemmas framed for users from 10 different countries, scoring the generated advice for individualism versus collectivism using LLM judges, and comparing the results against actual demographic data from the World Values Survey (WVS).

Using a 4-condition experimental design to isolate the effect of the prompt's language (English vs. native language) from the explicit country label to measure how linguistic cues versus stated geographic identity alter the values expressed by the model.
